sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在清晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能几乎每年都是联赛中最出色的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都使用不同的首字母单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一个平底锅就能做好的菜谱，因为我讨厌洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，陪伴您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可享受特别优惠，网址为nytimes.com斜杠subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Since his inauguration, President Trump has exercised a level of power that has directly challenged the checks and balances that, on paper, define the U.S.
sentences.zh: 自上任以来，特朗普总统行使了一种直接挑战制衡机制的权力，这种机制在理论上

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 定义了美国政府。

sentences.en: Today, I gathered three of my colleagues, Maggie Haberman, Jonathan Swan, and Charlie Savage, to talk about the absence of resistance
sentences.zh: 今天，我召集了我的三位同事——玛吉·哈伯曼、乔纳森·斯旺和查理·萨维奇，来谈谈这种缺乏抵抗的现象，

sentences.en: and about Trump's plans to make a more powerful presidency permanent.
sentences.zh: 以及特朗普让更强大的总统制永久化的计划。

sentences.en: It's Friday, January 31St.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月31日，星期五。

sentences.en: Friends, welcome back.
sentences.zh: 朋友们，欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Some of you, welcome to the roundtable.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人，欢迎来到圆桌讨论。

sentences.en: Charlie Savage, welcome.
sentences.zh: 查理·萨维奇，欢迎。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Maggie Haberman, as always a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 玛吉·哈伯曼，一如既往的高兴。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Jonathan Swan, welcome back.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森·斯旺，欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I want to start by asking you to describe, in a word, if you'll indulge this exercise, the past two weeks.
sentences.zh: 我想先请你们用一个词来形容过去的两周，如果你们不介意这个小游戏的话。

sentences.en: Just one word.
sentences.zh: 只需要一个词。

sentences.en: Intense.
sentences.zh: 紧张激烈。

sentences.en: Surprisingly well-planned.
sentences.zh: 出人意料地计划周密。

sentences.en: I know that's more than one word.
sentences.zh: 我知道这不止一个词。

sentences.en: Predicted.
sentences.zh: 在意料之中。

sentences.en: I knew one of you was going to say that.
sentences.zh: 我早就知道你们当中会有人这么说。

sentences.en: And that's because we have had a series of conversations with you three that, in many ways,
sentences.zh: 这是因为我们与你们三位进行了一系列对话，在许多方面，

sentences.en: prepared me, prepared all of our listeners for what the last two weeks, to a degree, have looked like.
sentences.zh: 这些对话让我、让我们的所有听众在某种程度上对过去两周的局势有了心理准备。

sentences.en: And that's why we asked you all to come back.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么我们邀请你们再次来到这里。

sentences.en: Let me just explain.
sentences.zh: 请允许我解释一下。

sentences.en: During the campaign, the three of you embarked on a reporting project to understand what Donald Trump's second term would look like.
sentences.zh: 在竞选期间，你们三人着手开展了一个报道项目，旨在了解唐纳德·特朗普的第二个任期会是什么样子。

sentences.en: The norms it would challenge, the presidential power it would seek to expand, and the ways in which it would test our democratic system of checks and balances.
sentences.zh: 它将挑战哪些规范，它将寻求扩大哪些总统权力，以及它将如何考验我们的民主制衡体系。

sentences.en: You all came on the show to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 你们都曾来到节目中谈论过这个话题。

sentences.en: We called the series Trump 2.0.
sentences.zh: 我们将这个系列命名为“特朗普2.0”。

sentences.en: And now that Trump is president and has unveiled such an aggressive and muscular agenda,
sentences.zh: 现在特朗普已经成为总统，并推出了如此激进且强有力的议程，

sentences.en: it made sense to have you back to assess and explain what he's done so far and how it maps on to what you had foreshadowed in that previous conversation.
sentences.zh: 请你们回来评估和解释他迄今为止的所作所为，以及这与你们在之前的对话中预示的内容如何契合，这就很有意义了。

sentences.en: So, I guess, Jonathan, since you used the word, maybe we'll start with you.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，乔纳森，既然你用了这个词，也许我们就从你开始吧。

sentences.en: But where should we start with predictions versus reality?
sentences.zh: 但是，对于预测与现实，我们应该从哪里开始谈起呢？

sentences.en: Well, I don't want to sound obnoxious, but pretty much everything that we wrote is coming to bear.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不想显得太自大，但我们写的内容几乎全都应验了。

sentences.en: That's not obnoxious, just for the record.
sentences.zh: 声明一下，这并不自大。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So, our first piece in the series was about the expansion of power.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们系列报道的第一篇是关于权力的扩张。

sentences.en: This idea of scouring the executive branch, looking for any pockets of independence, and removing them.
sentences.zh: 这种梳理行政分支、寻找任何独立派系并将其铲除的想法。

sentences.en: And we're now seeing early examples of Donald Trump doing that, firing officials who might be checks on him, ridding the executive branch of people who may be disloyal to him.
sentences.zh: 我们现在看到了唐纳德·特朗普这样做的早期例子，他解雇了那些可能对他构成制衡的官员，清洗了行政分支中可能对他不忠的人。

sentences.en: You have retribution as a theme that we came back to again and again and again, and you're seeing that play out in many different ways.
sentences.zh: 报复作为我们一遍又一遍反复提及的主题，你正在看到它以许多不同的方式上演。

sentences.en: We didn't even imagine, actually.
sentences.zh: 甚至是我们实际上未曾想象过的方式。

sentences.en: I suppose he defied our capacity for imagination when he decided to pull security details from people he doesn't like, who are under active death threats from Iran.
sentences.zh: 我想当他决定从那些他不喜欢的、正受到来自伊朗切实谋杀威胁的人身边撤走安保力量时，他超越了我们的想象能力。

sentences.en: But, you know, besides that, pretty much everything from his immigration agenda to his plans for the Justice Department, introducing figures like Kash Patel.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，除此之外，从他的移民议程到他对司法部的计划，再到引入卡什·帕特尔这样的人物，几乎所有事情都是如此。

sentences.en: Go down the list and immodestly kind of copy-paste our series, and you're basically getting what you're getting in the last eight to ten days.
sentences.zh: 顺着名单看下去，然后有点不知谦耻地复制粘贴我们的系列报道，你基本上就能明白过去八到十天里发生了什么。

sentences.en: Maggie, what has stood out to you as you contemplate what your reporting suggested this term might look like and what it's actually been in these first two weeks?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，当你想起你的报道所暗示的这一任期可能会是什么样子，以及它在最初这两周实际上的表现时，有什么让你印象深刻的？

sentences.en: As Jonathan said, we made clear that Trump and his allies were looking for ways to maximize the executive branch's power
sentences.zh: 正如乔纳森所说，我们曾明确表示，特朗普及其盟友正在寻找最大化行政分支权力的方法，

sentences.en: and that they believe this is constitutional, that they are arguing that certain checks on it are not constitutional,
sentences.zh: 并且他们认为这是合宪的，他们辩称对这种权力的某些限制是不合宪的，

sentences.en: and that they were prepared to take their chances in court and see what they could get away with.
sentences.zh: 而且他们准备在法庭上碰碰运气，看看他们能把事情推到什么地步。

sentences.en: Now, there was one blemish to that, which was this memo that went out from the Office of Management and Budget
sentences.zh: 现在，其中有一个瑕疵，那就是管理和预算办公室发出的一份备忘录，

sentences.en: that froze congressionally approved funding for federal aid and grants across government and created mass confusion and ultimately was rescinded.
sentences.zh: 该备忘录冻结了国会批准的用于整个政府的联邦援助和赠款资金，造成了大规模混乱，最终被撤销。

sentences.en: So that was them testing the limits and not succeeding.
sentences.zh: 所以那是他们在试探底线却没有成功。

sentences.en: That was the rare problem point for them.
sentences.zh: 那是他们少有的受挫点。

sentences.en: Everything else they have done, particularly as pertains to immigration, has worked the way they've wanted it to.
sentences.zh: 他们所做的一切，特别是与移民相关的部分，都完全按照他们想要的方式运作了。

sentences.en: Which is to say what?
sentences.zh: 也就是说什么？

sentences.en: How has it worked?
sentences.zh: 它是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: Which is to say that they have not been stymied by loud protests.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，他们并没有被喧嚣的抗议活动所阻挠。

sentences.en: They have had some court challenges that they expected, but those have just kind of gone on in workmanlike fashion as opposed to the resistance that we saw in 2017.
sentences.zh: 他们遭遇了一些意料之中的法庭诉讼，但这些诉讼都只是按部就班地进行，而不像我们在2017年看到的那些强烈抵抗。

sentences.en: And they are hitting some numbers on arrests of migrants who they say have criminal records.
sentences.zh: 他们抓捕了一定数量被指控有犯罪记录的移民。

sentences.en: And they are narrating that and making mugshots available and making public these numbers about the volume of people who they have arrested.
sentences.zh: 他们正在叙述这一切，公开嫌疑人犯案大头照，并公布他们逮捕人数的统计数据。

sentences.en: And mostly, Michael, they're facing a pretty dampened Democratic pushback, especially compared to what we saw in 2020.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，迈克尔，他们面临的民主党推回力度相当薄弱，尤其是与我们在2020年看到的情况相比。

sentences.en: Charlie, I want to ask you how much these actions that the president and those around him have taken over the past two weeks are testing the limits of presidential power
sentences.zh: 查理，我想问你，过去两周里总统及其身边人采取的这些行动，在多大程度上是在试探总统权力的极限

sentences.en: and just the law.
sentences.zh: 以及法律的底线？

sentences.en: And Maggie started to hint at this, how the rest of government, both legislative and judicial branches, the checks and balances, are responding or not responding.
sentences.zh: 玛吉刚才已经暗示了这一点，即政府的其他部门——立法部门和司法部门，也就是制衡机制——是如何反应的，或者说没有反应。

sentences.en: I think I would divide that into different categories of things.
sentences.zh: 我想我把它分为不同类别的事情。

sentences.en: The immigration actions that Maggie was just describing are mostly within the parameters of what everyone agrees the statutes on the books already say,
sentences.zh: 玛吉刚才描述的移民行动，大部分都在大家公认的现有成文法参数范围内，

sentences.en: with the big exception of the attempt to redefine birthright citizenship.
sentences.zh: 一个重大的例外是试图重新定义出生公民权。

sentences.en: And so that's making very aggressive use of powers, but it's not pushing, for the most part, at the limits of those powers in terms of,
sentences.zh: 因此，这是对权力非常激进的使用，但就以下问题而言，它在大多数情况下并没有突破这些权力的极限：

sentences.en: is this actually a legitimate thing you have the authority to do?
sentences.zh: 这真的是你合法有权做的事情吗？

sentences.en: The assault on the federal workforce, the mass firing of inspectors general, in the firing of a member of the National Labor Relations Board,
sentences.zh: 对联邦劳动力队伍的攻击，对总监察长的大规模解雇，对国家劳资关系委员会成员的解雇，

sentences.en: in the firing of various civil servants, including all the Justice Department trial lawyers who just were assigned to work on any of the Trump cases, for example,
sentences.zh: 对各种公务员的解雇，包括所有刚刚被指派负责任何特朗普相关案件的司法部出庭律师，

sentences.en: blowing through explicit legal protections for federal workers.
sentences.zh: 这些都全然无视了对联邦员工的明确法律保护。

sentences.en: All of these things, though, he and his appointees just did.
sentences.zh: 然而，所有这些事情，他和他的任命官员都直接做了。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why do something that, assuming there are lawyers in the government who are as smart as you, why do it?
sentences.zh: 为什么要做出这样的举动——假设政府里有和你们一样聪明的律师——为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: So I've argued that the way to understand this is it looks like they're inviting all these lawsuits,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为理解这一点的关键在于，这看起来像是在引诱所有的诉讼，

sentences.en: all these people who are getting fired are going to sue because they're going to say, you couldn't do that.
sentences.zh: 所有这些被解雇的人都将提起诉讼，因为他们会说，你不能那样做。

sentences.en: Look at this law.
sentences.zh: 看看这条法律。

sentences.en: You just violated the law.
sentences.zh: 你刚刚违法了。

sentences.en: And perversely, that may be exactly what they want.
sentences.zh: 而反常的是，这可能正是他们想要的。

sentences.en: You're going to have to explain that.
sentences.zh: 你得解释一下这一点。

sentences.en: This theory of expansive presidential power that Jonathan was referring to, this sort of revisionist understanding of the Constitution that kind of dates back to the
sentences.zh: 乔纳森刚才提到的这种扩张性总统权力的理论，这种可以追溯到里根政府时期的、对宪法的修正主义理解，即总统必须对政府拥有专属控制权，

sentences.en: Reagan administration, the president must have exclusive control of the government,
sentences.zh: 因此国会缺乏合法的权力通过任何法案，来对总统随意解雇任何人的能力施加任何形式的限制，

sentences.en: and Congress therefore lacks legitimate authority to pass laws that create any kind of limitation
sentences.zh: 或者在政府的任何地方制造任何形式的独立决策权。

sentences.en: on the president's ability to fire anyone he wants or creates any kind of pockets of independent decision-making authority anywhere in the government.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图把所有这些统统根除。

sentences.en: They were trying to stomp all these things out.
sentences.zh: 那么你如何根除它们呢？

sentences.en: And so how do you stomp them out?
sentences.zh: 你在违反法律的情况下解雇某人，此人提起诉讼，然后你让最高法院中由共和党总统任命的大法官宣布

sentences.en: You fire the person in the face of this law, the person files a lawsuit, and then you get the Republican appointees on the Supreme Court to say
sentences.zh: 该法律违宪，从而创造一个扩大行政权力含义的先例。

sentences.en: that law is unconstitutional and create a precedent that expands what executive power means.
sentences.zh: 我想总结一下，因为这个想法有点复杂，但感觉非常重要。

sentences.en: I just want to summarize that because it's a little bit of a complicated thought, feels very important.
sentences.zh: 你是在暗示，总统采取的一些行动——尤其是当他似乎在摆脱那些在法律上有非常明确工作保障的联邦雇员时——

sentences.en: You're suggesting that some of the actions the president is taking, especially when he seems to be getting rid of federal workers who would seem to have
sentences.zh: 其目的是触发一个法律程序，最终提交给由共和党任命的大法官占多数的最高法院，而这些法官不会站在工会一边，而是会站在特朗普一边，

sentences.en: very clear job protections within the law, is that he wants them to trigger a legal process that ends
sentences.zh: 并在这一过程中实质性地重新定义和扩大总统权力。

sentences.en: before a Republican appointee majority of the Supreme Court justices who then rule, not in the favor of the workers, but in favor of Trump, and essentially redefine and expand
sentences.zh: 但是并不能保证这一定会发生，不过在白宫目前的意识形态下，这个过程本身就值得去做吗？

sentences.en: presidential power in the process.
sentences.zh: 这要看情况。

sentences.en: But there's no guarantee that that's going to happen, but is the journey itself just worthwhile under the current ideology of this White House?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，迈克尔，我不认为最高法院在每一种情况下都会向特朗普屈服，但他们的确拥有保守派超级多数，这给特朗普及其盟友带来了巨大的希望。

sentences.en: It depends.
sentences.zh: 我也想提一点，乔纳森也应该回答这个问题，但我确实想强调另一个观点。

sentences.en: I mean, Michael, I don't think in every single case that the Supreme Court is going to cede to Trump, but they do have a conservative supermajority, and that gives a lot of hope to
sentences.zh: 狂轰滥炸就是一切。

sentences.en: Trump and his allies.
sentences.zh: 他们采取了如此之多的不同行动，以至于媒体和他的批评者根本应接不暇。

sentences.en: I also just want to, and Jonathan should answer this question as well, but I do want to make one other point.
sentences.zh: 所以你打出10发子弹，也许有两发命中，对他们来说这就感觉像是一场胜利，但乔纳森可能会有更好的回答。

sentences.en: Flooding the zone is everything.
sentences.zh: 不，不，我同意所有这些看法。

sentences.en: They are taking so many different actions that it is incredibly hard for the media and for his critics to keep up.
sentences.zh: 法院在方向上非常明确地走在扩大行政权力以及对第二条权力进行广义解释的道路上。

sentences.en: And so you lob 10 shots and maybe two work, and for them that feels like a win, but Jonathan probably has a better answer.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们相信最高法院在许多情况下会做出对他们有利的裁决，即国会限制总统、在行政分支内部设立这些制衡机制的努力是违宪的。

sentences.en: No, no, I agree with all that.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，他们早就发出过信号。

sentences.en: The court pretty clearly directionally is on the path of expanding executive power and having a broad interpretation of Article 2 power.
sentences.zh: 这不是什么新鲜事。

sentences.en: So they feel confident that this court will, in many cases, rule in their favor that these efforts by Congress to
sentences.zh: 在大选前的几个月里，我们在与他们交谈时，他的人就说过，这正是他们的目的，那就是让案件走完法院系统。

sentences.en: restrain the president to put these checks within the executive branch are unconstitutional.
sentences.zh: 我们对自己的胜算很有信心。

sentences.en: And by the way, they've telegraphed this.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不同于2017年的最高法院。

sentences.en: This is not new.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不同的联邦司法体系，因为唐纳德·特朗普本人改变了它。

sentences.en: For months before the election, his people were saying when we were talking to them that this was kind of the point, was let it go through the court system.
sentences.zh: 并不是唐纳德·特朗普发生了深刻的变化。

sentences.en: We like our chances.
sentences.zh: 而是他重返的华盛顿变了，体制上的护栏已经侵蚀。

sentences.en: This is a different Supreme Court than existed in 2017.
sentences.zh: 法院系统不同了。

sentences.en: It's a different federal judiciary because Donald Trump himself transformed it.
sentences.zh: 国会已经很难再算是一个平等的政权分支了。

sentences.en: It's not that Donald Trump has profoundly changed.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们再多谈谈这一点，乔纳森，既然你引出了这个话题。

sentences.en: It's that the Washington he returns to has changed and the institutional guardrails have eroded.
sentences.zh: 对于特朗普签署的许多行政命令，国会本可以采取行动。

sentences.en: The court system is different.
